Instead, I'll have the Dockerfile clone the upstream repo directly during the build, so the container always runs the real, unmodified app. Let me package this for kitbash.

name: getting-started-app
description: Docker's official getting-started tutorial todo app (docker/getting-started-app), built from upstream source.
deploy:
  units:
    - type: container
      build: .
      expose: http
      mounts:
        - { source: /home/bench-20260919-2334/getting-started-app-data, target: /etc/todos, mode: rw }

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM node:22-alpine

RUN apk add --no-cache git

WORKDIR /app
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/docker/getting-started-app.git . \
    && npm install --omit=dev

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "src/index.js"]
